cpp-template-inherited-base-signature.item: - The inherited traversal calls `cpp_direct_base_types` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3023`), which reads `unit.signature()` and uses source text when that is absent (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3211`). Class `CodeUnit`s carry `scope.template_signature` in their identity `signature` field, the value `CodeUnit::signature` returns (`src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:317`, `src/analyzer/model.rs:355`). That field is assigned from `cpp_template_signature` (`src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:207`), whose value consists of the template parameter head, without the class base clause (`src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:1317`).
cpp-template-inherited-base-signature.why: All elements of the single pair are kept, the preference over source text being restated as a fallback; the edited line states the census fact.

go-nilness-ignores-modeled-nonreturn.item: - `complete_modeled_call_facts` requires `complete: true` (`crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/effects.rs:2586`); `proves_normal_continuation_absent` evaluates exact active-model agreement, and its result is independent of summary completeness (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/runtime.rs:432`); the `testing.T.Fatal` model declares `completeness: "partial"` and `normal_continuation_absent: true` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/models/go-stdlib-testing.json:474`).
go-nilness-ignores-modeled-nonreturn.why: The edited line lists the T.Fatal model as a separate clause and drops the 'including' link stating that proves_normal_continuation_absent's completeness-independent evaluation applies to that partial summary; a reader must infer it.
elements_not_kept: relation: the completeness-independent evaluation covers ('including') testing.T.Fatal's partial summary

go-receiver-poisons-package-result-contr.item: - The empty-open-lookup check calls `may_name_result_contract`, whose inventory tuple at insertion and at lookup is `(language, member, parameter_count)`; the tuple fields do not include `summary.target.has_receiver` or call receiver applicability (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/effects.rs:492; crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/effects.rs:263; crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/effects.rs:283).
go-receiver-poisons-package-result-contr.why: Pair 1 drops the statement that receiverless summaries and receiver calls with the same tuple share an inventory entry, so the receiver collision in the census fact must be inferred from the key omission.
elements_not_kept: key rule: receiverless summaries and receiver calls with the same tuple share one inventory entry

incompatible-semantic-bundle-late-gate.item: - `verify_release_bundle` calls `verify_checksums`, which hashes each asset listed in `SHA256SUMS` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1728`, `crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2382`), then decodes each curated manifest and shard (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1733`, `crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1777`), then calls `verify_generated_production` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1793`), which checks generated schema and cache versions (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2059`, `crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2065`).
incompatible-semantic-bundle-late-gate.why: All sites, orders and values are kept; the edited line states the census fact.

java-static-getter-drops-incomplete-rout.item: - Kotlin property extraction emits a `ResolutionJvmAliasKind::Getter` alias with `is_static` set to `top_level` (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/resolution.rs:2309); the alias target is the property declaration, registered in the Value namespace (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/resolution.rs:1487). The alias reader matches each alias row's kind and static flag against the import demand namespace (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_operation/jvm_context.rs:2339).
java-static-getter-drops-incomplete-rout.why: All elements of the three pairs are kept; pair 1's edited line states the census fact.

js-synthetic-owner-leaks-file-summary.item: - `signature_elements` reads `analyzer.ranges(code_unit)` (`src/searchtools.rs:1162`) and, for signature index `i`, sets `start_line` from `ranges[i]` and `end_line` from `max(text.lines().count(), ranges[i].end_line - ranges[i].start_line + 1)` (`src/searchtools.rs:1176`, `src/searchtools.rs:1190`), with `text` set to the signature (`src/searchtools.rs:1198`). The JS/TS adapters register the module unit with `add_code_unit(module, root, ...)` and `add_signature(module, import_statements.join("\n"))` (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`).
js-synthetic-owner-leaks-file-summary.why: The extent rule is not kept: the edited line assigns the max line count to end_line rather than to the element's line extent, and it adds a start_line source; the whole-file coverage in the census fact therefore needs inference.
elements_not_kept: rule: each element extent (line count) is the maximum of signature line count and matching range line count (searchtools.rs:1176, 1190)
added: end_line stated as max(signature line count, range line count) itself, whereas the code computes start_line + max(...) - 1

jvm-protected-unindexed-hierarchy-denied.item: - `jvm_type_is_subtype` initializes `uncertain` to false (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_resolution.rs:26549) and its assignments to `uncertain` all occur inside the loop over returned supertype edges (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_resolution.rs:26562); for distinct types with an empty supertype inventory it returns `Some(false)` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_resolution.rs:26597); the function has no hierarchy-closure check.
jvm-protected-unindexed-hierarchy-denied.why: All elements are kept; the absence of a closure check is restated for the function as a whole, and the edited line states the census fact.

kotlin-source-constructor-steals-class-h.item: - The source primary constructor registered as a class child (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/declarations.rs:409) enters comment-density traversal through Kotlin's child filter, which excludes synthetic units (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/mod.rs:675); collection expands the ranges of each child it receives and has no primary-constructor check (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/comment_density.rs:162, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/comment_density.rs:181), and `enclosing_declaration` picks, among declarations with a range containing a comment, the one of greatest depth (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/comment_density.rs:248).
kotlin-source-constructor-steals-class-h.why: All elements are kept and the edited line states the census fact.

kotlin-value-class-this-loses-underlying.why: All elements are kept and the edited line states the census fact.

mcp-default-advisory-reported-clean.item: - The MCP options builder sets no inconclusive option (`crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:3619`); the options default for that field is `Pass` (`crates/bifrost-policy/src/coordinator.rs:326`). `run_policy` picks its public `status` string by matching `outcome.exit_status()`, where `POLICY_EXIT_CLEAN` matches `clean`, and places `outcome.into_report()` in the same result (`crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:7024`, `crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:7039`).
mcp-default-advisory-reported-clean.why: All elements of both pairs are kept; pair 0's edited line states the census fact.

php-indexed-write-reenters-current-rhs.item: - `collection_element_type_fq_name` passes `collection.start_byte()` as `before_byte` and a callback to `instance_receiver_type_fq_name_inner` (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1548`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1553`). `infer_indexed_local_element_type` walks the enclosing scope (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1393`), skips nodes whose start byte is at or after `before_byte` and does not read an assignment's end byte (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1401`), and calls `resolve_value(right)` for each indexed write to the collection variable whose start byte is below `before_byte`, independent of where that assignment ends (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1421`).
php-indexed-write-reenters-current-rhs.why: The condition that resolve_value runs even when the assignment encloses the current collection read is generalized to 'independent of where that assignment ends'; the enclosing case, which is part of the census fact, must be inferred.
elements_not_kept: condition: even when the assignment encloses the current collection read

python-filescope-enclosing-tie.item: - `PythonAdapter::parse_file` registers the real module with the tree root node's range (`src/analyzer/python/adapter.rs:78`, `src/analyzer/python/adapter.rs:84`); `add_file_scope` records the synthetic `FileScope` range as bytes `0..source.len()` (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:327`), which is also the root node's byte range when the root covers the whole source.
python-filescope-enclosing-tie.why: All elements of the three pairs are kept; pair 2's edited line states the census fact.

python-module-binding-representative-aft.item: - Module assignments that repeat a name construct the same `Field` CodeUnit at each assignment and each call `replace_code_unit`, which removes the unit's `ranges` entry and then adds the current assignment node as its declaration; the `ranges` map is keyed by CodeUnit, and after the last assignment it holds that assignment's range, with no entry per binding event (`crates/bifrost-python/src/declarations.rs:551`, `crates/bifrost-python/src/declarations.rs:569`, `crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/parsed_file.rs:274`, `crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/parsed_file.rs:425`); `analyzer.ranges(candidate)` in the event selector reads these ranges (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1773`).
python-module-binding-representative-aft.why: Every original element is kept, but pair 2's edited line adds a new key fact, that the ranges map is keyed by CodeUnit.
elements_not_kept: added: the ranges map is keyed by CodeUnit

python-module-mutation-repeated-scan-bud.item: - `class_hierarchy` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/python/hierarchy.rs:373`) creates a `ResolutionSession` with `bounded_with_total_work` and one `PythonDefinitionProvider` over it for the ancestry traversal, and passes that budget into `runtime_source_bases` for each workspace owner (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/python/hierarchy.rs:441`); in its loop over base nodes, `runtime_source_bases` calls `python_class_object_base_candidate` with `budget.provider` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/python/hierarchy.rs:711`), and that function reaches its module-binding guard (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1963`).
python-module-mutation-repeated-scan-bud.why: All elements are kept and the edited line states the census fact.

retained-fill-java-memo-loses-gap.item: - `JavaSource::unique_class_by_fqn_in_file` reads and writes the request-domain `JavaFileClassIndexMemo`, whose values are `Arc<JavaFileClassIndex>` (`crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:787`, `crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:695`); the lookup returns a stored index as is, with no build-gap replay step, and on a lookup miss the function builds an index from `declarations(file)` and inserts it, with no completion check (`crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:799`, `crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:801`, `crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:803`).
retained-fill-java-memo-loses-gap.why: All elements are kept and the edited line states the census fact.

unproven-override-family-certifies-empty.item: - `MemberFamilyAnswer::is_proven` compares the outcome with `Proven` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/member_family.rs:146`). The hierarchy helper collects `ImplementedBy`/`OverriddenBy` targets when `is_proven` is true and constructs an empty vector when it is false; after either branch it returns `Some(targets)` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:945`). The `Some(overrides) if overrides.is_empty()` arm matches a `Some` holding an empty vector (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:554`).
unproven-override-family-certifies-empty.why: The edited line only says the empty-Some arm matches a Some holding an empty vector; it drops the statement that both empty-vector routes from the helper, including the unproven one, enter that arm.
elements_not_kept: relation: both empty-vector routes (proven-empty and unproven) enter the Some(overrides) if overrides.is_empty() arm (dispatch.rs:554)
